description: This file implements CMAC (Cipher-based Message Authentication Code) functions using OpenSSL, including context management, initialization, update, finalization, and the core AES-CMAC algorithm with support for different key sizes.

classes.name: cmac_ctx_st
classes.description: Structure holding CMAC context including cipher state, subkeys, and buffer.

methods.name: CMAC_CTX_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the CMAC context, freeing resources and cleansing sensitive data.

methods.name: AES_CMAC
methods.description: Computes the CMAC of input data using AES with specified key size.

methods.name: CMAC_CTX_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new CMAC context.

methods.name: CMAC_CTX_copy
methods.description: Copies one CMAC context to another.

methods.name: CMAC_Init
methods.description: Initializes the CMAC context with a key and cipher.

methods.name: CMAC_Reset
methods.description: Resets the CMAC context for reuse.

methods.name: CMAC_Update
methods.description: Updates the CMAC with additional input data.

methods.name: CMAC_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the CMAC computation and outputs the tag.
